精灵族的修仙者最新章节_第338章 劫前准备第1页_精灵族的修仙者左手打右脑_热点小说网
> 第338章 劫前准备（第1页）
一个突如其来的消息，引爆了整个晨曦大陆。
血吼要塞、群山之心、自由同盟与翡翠王庭，四大势力联合突袭了海族位于圣龙山脉东南侧的营地。
鏖战持续了整整一日一夜，海族在多方夹击下损失惨重，最终被迫放弃滩头阵地，退入湖中，沿着水道仓惶撤离了圣龙山脉周边区域。
封氏集团近年来势头很盛，足以同霍氏并驾齐驱，分庭抗礼……这还只是明面上的功夫，背地里见不得光的交易，更是横跨黑白两道，让人怎么死的都不知道。
“来不及了！”叶开敛起眼光波，收起身上的火焰，飞闪到下面，将冬梅一具娇躯一把搂抱起来。
许峰从背包中叼出枯骨拼图，待他松开嘴后，枯骨拼图主动漂浮到水晶棺材上空，图纸上的花纹闪耀着诡异的光芒，同时不断在系统栏中进行提示，是否完成拼图？
屠诗理解玩家的做法，但他不会同流合污。他也不管那些食髓知味的玩家，继续行走。
苏晓棠、苏母、刘大兰和苏晓美四人也端起杯子，象征性的碰了碰杯，然后都一口干了杯中的香槟酒。
最起码到现在还活着的那批血族最次的也是侯爵了，从伯爵开始大部分血族其实都是千年圣战之后出生的新生儿了。
她抬起双手，不见任何动作，两团火焰从她洁白如玉的纤手一下升腾出。
临走之前，她还不忘狠狠瞪了一眼苏晓棠，认为是苏晓棠太矫情，害她在人前丢这么大脸。
看着苏晓棠熟悉得不能再熟悉的面容，顾远好想好想将她揽入怀中，轻声告诉她一句。
叶开感觉黑影套装虽卸了不少炸力，可他背后伤势还是非常严重。
玉卿在一旁冷静的看着眼前这一切，心里隐隐约约的有些担心起来。
“哼，我等不过只是借用他一个名头罢了，真要得到他们的封赏吗？”那人不服道。
紫玄狼，在妖兽序列中，等级很高阶，最主要的原因，在于它能够在不同的战斗中，不停地进化和变异。
封林可是听自己老爹说过，这个姒韵的后台在第一次元都是可怕的存在。
平阳公主闻言，却是不信，她从府外到府堂叫了好几声皇上，就是傻子也该知道坐在上面的是当今皇上。

“你、你这……你这是偷梁换柱，”落红瑛没想到他居然会如此回答，开口声音不由结巴了起来，更是词不达意。
许久，他开始将手放在了李明眸举过头顶的那只褪上，轻轻扶着它，让柳明眸扶着桌子的手，能够解脱出来。
此时已经到了中午，连云城回到房间里，立即暗暗的打坐运气恢复内力。
“孟子凡去了江南，这傻逼怎么飘忽不定的？！”王金童再次意外的问了一句。
“不清楚？他们说她是共党，师长，那可是我妹妹，我世上唯一的亲人，你得帮我想想办法。”赵大刀着急道。
“那还真是抱歉，这也与我们有些关系。”娘娘捋了捋被风吹乱的头发。但是风这么大，她这么捋也无法捋顺，干脆动了一个念头，让风全都绕开了这个天台。
只是，这些情况，顾母却并不知道，所以，在顾母的眼中，儿子身上的这些变化，正表明了儿子如今早已经不再是以往的那个花心大少，而变成了一个不爱姑娘爱念经的苦行僧。

The latest chapter of the Immortal Cultivator of the Elf Tribe_Chapter 338 Preparation before the Tribulation Page 1_The Immortal Cultivator of the Elf Tribe hits his right brain with his left hand_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 338 Preparation before the Tribulation (Page 1)
A sudden news detonated the entire Dawn Continent.
The four major forces, Bloodhowl Fortress, Heart of the Mountains, Freedom Alliance and Emerald King's Court, jointly raided the Sea Clan's camp on the southeast side of the Holy Dragon Mountains.
The fierce battle lasted for a whole day and night. The Hai clan suffered heavy losses from multiple attacks and were finally forced to abandon their beachhead position, retreat into the lake, and evacuate the area around the Shenglong Mountains along the waterways in a panic.
The Feng Group has gained great momentum in recent years, and is able to keep pace with the Huo Group and compete with each other... This is only the effort on the surface, and the shady transactions behind the scenes span both black and white, making people die without knowing how.
"It's too late!" Ye Kai suppressed his gaze, put away the flames on his body, flew down, and hugged Dong Mei's delicate body.
Xu Feng took out the bone puzzle from his backpack. After he let go of his mouth, the bone puzzle automatically floated to the sky above the crystal coffin. The patterns on the drawing shone with a strange light. At the same time, the system bar kept prompting, have you completed the puzzle?
Tu Shi understands what the players are doing, but he will not join in. He didn't care about those players who knew the taste and kept walking.
Su Xiaotang, Su Mu, Liu Dalan and Su Xiaomei also picked up their glasses, clinked them symbolically, and then drank the champagne in their glasses.
At least the youngest of the vampires still alive today is the Marquis. Starting from the count, most of the vampires are actually newborns born after the Thousand Years of Holy War.
She raised her hands without any movement, and two balls of flames rose up from her delicate white hands.
Before leaving, she did not forget to glare at Su Xiaotang fiercely, thinking that Su Xiaotang was too pretentious and caused her to be so embarrassed in front of others.
Looking at Su Xiaotang's extremely familiar face, Gu Yuan really wanted to hold her in his arms and tell her softly.
Ye Kai felt that although the black shadow suit had relieved a lot of explosive power, the injuries on his back were still very serious.
Yu Qing calmly watched everything in front of her, feeling vaguely worried.
"Hmph, I'm just borrowing his name. Do I really want to get their reward?" The man said unconvinced.
The Zixuan Wolf has a very high level in the monster sequence. The main reason is that it can continuously evolve and mutate in different battles.
Feng Lin heard his father say that Si Yun's backstage was a terrifying existence in the first dimension.
Princess Pingyang heard this, but she didn't believe it. She went to the palace from outside and called the emperor several times. Even a fool should know that the person sitting on it was the current emperor.
"You, you... you're trying to steal something," Luo Hongying didn't expect that he would answer like this. Her voice couldn't help but stutter, and she couldn't express what she meant.
After a while, he began to put his hand on the one that Li Mingmou raised above his head, and gently supported it, so that Liu Mingmou's hand holding the table could be freed.
It was already noon. Lianyun Cheng returned to the room and immediately meditated secretly to restore his internal strength.
"Meng Zifan went to Jiangnan, why is this idiot so erratic?!" Wang Jintong asked again unexpectedly.
"Not sure? They said she is a Communist, sir, but she is my sister, my only relative in the world. You have to help me think of a way." Zhao Dadao said anxiously.
"Then I'm really sorry. This has something to do with us." The empress smoothed her hair that was messed up by the wind. But the wind was so strong that she couldn't smooth it out, so she simply had an idea to let the wind bypass the rooftop.
However, Gu's mother didn't know about these circumstances. Therefore, in Gu's eyes, these changes in her son showed that her son was no longer the same as before.He was a carefree young man, and turned into an ascetic who didn't love girls and loved chanting sutras.
